page.layout: One column of running text, printed page 307. Running head at the top centre. No marginal notes. Catchword at bottom right. Signature mark at bottom left.

main_text.p: quàm quod vetustiores scriptum reliquis-sent. Nam praeter Clementem, Eusebium, & Hieronymum, de quibus diximus supra, & paucissimos alios, caeteri ad ipsorum fidè haud obscurè provocant. Theodoretus, Φασὶ μεθερμηνευσαι τὴν Κλήμεντος, nempe dixerat Eusebius. Oecumenius, ὕστερον μεθερμηνευθῆναι λέγεται. Ambrosius (nisi quis alius sit) Sunt qui ajunt Paulum hanc Epistolam propriâ linguâ scripsisse & misisse. Stephanus apud Photium Cod. ccxxxii[?]. Εὐσέβιος καὶ πολὺς ἄλλ ὁ τῶν θεοφόρων πατέρων ὁμολ[?], &c. Φασὶν ἐκ τῆς Ἐβραΐδος μεταφέρσαι τὴν Κλήμεντα. Sic videmus plerosq; recètiores, fide quasi implicitâ, re non expensâ, non à difficultatibus suis liberatâ, assensum praebere suum. Imò & ipse ὁ πάνυ Salmasius, apertâ hic se contradictione superiùs implicabat. Et solitus in istiusmodi plus nimium tribuere Hieronymo, aliisque nonnullis Veterum. Imò quod magis est, sui saepè oblitus, modò affirmat, modò negat. E re nostrâ est, exemplum promere luculentum, & quod vix fidé apud Lectores impetrabit. Quum

page.notes: Greek passages are transcribed from the scan and may contain letter errors; the Greek in the Cod. ccxxxii line and the Εὐσέβιος line are the least certain and carry [?] where doubtful. The catchword "idem," and the signature are read from the foot of the page. The page number 307 and running head "ad Hebraeos." are printed at the top. The first and last words of the text are a fragment at the page break ("quàm", "Quum"), which continues on the following page.
